first_denial.text: I just checked my email and found a response from [person] at The Melody SF. There's a significant pricing discrepancy from what we expected - they're actually charging $15,500 for full venue rental (8 hours including setup/cleanup) or $7,500 for under 100 people. This is dramatically higher than the $275/hr ($1,100 total) we initially understood. The rental includes full audio/lighting, AV tech support, security, tables, 150 chairs, lounge furniture, and projection capabilities. However, this pricing exceeds both our current fundraising ($1,481) and our projected budget ($2,600).
